caption: The drawing depicts a manual coffee grinder consisting of a square wooden box with dovetail joints, a small central drawer with a round metal knob, and a tray-like base that extends slightly beyond the box's footprint. Mounted on top of the box is a metallic, cone-shaped hopper with a wide circular opening, tinged with muted shades of yellow and green. The hopper is secured by a metal flange with visible bolts or fasteners. Extending from the center of the hopper is a metal crank handle with a round wooden knob at the end, oriented to the right. The composition is centered with the grinder placed at an angle, showing two visible sides of the box and the crank stretching to the upper right. The background is plain, light beige with no other objects or decorations. The artist's signature, "ARCHIE THIMMESON," is visible in small capital letters on the lower right side of the image.
title: Coffee Mill
